1.consolidated_definition: educ. Blog educativo. Blog dedicado a temas educativos, generalmente hecho por alguien con preparación académica. Anglicismo crudo, frecuente. Existen una gran variedad de blogs y entre ellos los denominados edublogs o blogs educativos, cuyo fin principal, como sugiere el concepto, es respaldar el proceso pedagógico (El Nuevo Día, 02-05-08)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Educational blog. An educational blog dedicated to educational topics, generally created by someone with academic credentials. Raw anglicism, common. There exists a great variety of blogs, including those referred to as edublogs or educational blogs, whose primary purpose, as suggested by the concept, is to support the pedagogical process (The New Day, 02-05-08)
